text:
alex.p: Quick framing — want to lock invite segmentation + fallthrough plan for DP beta tomorrow. Goal: 24 partners across 3 buckets (SMB, Platform, Regulated). Need clarity on incentives, feedback cadence, and what we can promise for SLA/rollouts. Thoughts?

mira: +1. If we do 3 buckets, suggest 12 SMB, 8 Platform, 4 Regulated. Regulated should get private deploy option & NDA.

tony: For scope control, cap Private on-boarding to 2 Regulated early adopters at launch to avoid ops churn.

sophia: Measurement proposal: primary success = weekly active integrations (target 14/24 within 4 weeks). Secondary = qualitative NPS >= 8 and 3 case-study-ready customers.

jordan: Incentives sketch: Platform partners = $5k credits + co-marketing; SMB = $1k credits; Regulated = dedicated onboarding + prioritized infra slots.

mira: Feedback cadence idea: weekly 45-min sync + triage board. Async: #dp-feedback slack channel and shared Google Sheet for feature votes.

alex.p: Fallthrough plan idea: if private deploy delayed >2 weeks, fallback = hosted with dedicated capacity + customer data separation contract. Legal/ops signoff needed.

ops-bot: @channel FYI: private deploy queue length is 3, ETA for new onprem package ~3 weeks.

tony: Engineering note — we can do hosted-fallback but need partners to enable usage logs and opt into debug mode. Also require 3-month pilot commitment for private infra.

sophia: Can we build a prompt-set baseline for each partner? Propose 30-50 representative prompts seeded by partner and a standard eval harness.

mira: Recruit intake template (drafted below) — short, focused. Will iterate.

```
Name:
Company:
Use case:
Top 3 success metrics:
Preferred env: hosted/dedicated/private
Integration ETA (weeks):
Consent: co-marketing? yes/no
```

alex.p: Acceptance criteria to consider before shipping the invite: 1) >=20 partners enrolled 2) feedback loop and channel created 3) monitoring dashboard for error rate + cost delta live 4) rollback/fallback documented and tested.

jordan: Add: CS SLA for pilot: initial response <=24h for P1, follow-ups within 72h.

mira: Also require explicit opt-in for post-pilot case study and timeline (we'll push marketing collateral only with permission).

alex.p: Action items: mira — finalize invite + intake by EOD; sophia — build eval prompt sets by Tue; eng (tony) — confirm private fallback config by Wed; legal — review NDA + hosted-fallback wording. I'll coordinate ops capacity.

jordan: I'll assemble a 10-12 minute onboarding playbook and checklist for partners.

sophia: I'll prep dashboard template: active integrations, avg latency, cost delta / partner, qualitative NPS notes.

alex.p: Thanks all — let's sync tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
